decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (01 (Site Location and Block Plans) Received: 19 November 2017 
01 (Existing floor plans),02 (Existing Elevations),03 (Proposed floor plans) and 04 (Proposed elevations) Received: 17 November 2017 
Planning Statement Received: 27 October 2017, Flood Risk Assessment Received: 27 October 2017) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a first floor side extension incorporating roof windows and a single storey rear extension to the house
